notes.title: Corona MotorSport Beta Development Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year Everybody!
It's been quite sometime since I've been active on here, a lot has happened in my personal life that has affected the amount of time that I've been able to put towards development. Some of those things were wonderful, I graduated with my Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science back in May from UNC Asheville and got my first full-time position as a remote Software Engineer/Unity Developer for a small company in Asheville. But, I also lost two very close family members within months of each other and I've been left to pick up the pieces and deal with the grief that has come along with it. However, I've still managed to find chunks of time here and there to continue working on Corona. My research on CoronaAI is still in progress so the AI system is the only main ticket item remaining for the update. Rather than delaying the update even more, I have decided that I will enable Beta testing for the latest version without any AI while keeping the current 2018 Alpha version with AI live on the store. More details will be coming this week, but in the meantime, thank you for all your support throughout all these years! It's meant the world to me.
Warm regards,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8068925/dca660010c0ef05cd352d997fda111e6fe5b9b86.png[/img]
Luke Japaridze
Lead Developer

notes.title: Corona MotorSport Beta Set to Release Q4 2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8068925/d0b14f636bd543c8beed0a8ee7b2f37cfce946d8.jpg[/img]
The wait will soon be over! After over 19 months of development, the first Beta version of Corona MotorSport will be ready for the public! Here's a list of what to expect so far, I may add more features:

[h1]Physics[/h1]
The driving force and foundation of Corona MotorSport have been the vehicle physics, which are now regarded as flawed, unstable and largely obsolete. That is about to change.
[list]
[*]Replaced vehicle physics with a combination of proprietary and new third-party solutions.
[*]Vehicles now have a lower performance overhead (thus increasing game performance), are more responsive and handle more realistically.
[*]3D tire simulation
[*]Forced induction simulation (turbo and supercharged vehicles)
[*]Improved damage system with performance degredation 
[/list]
[h1]Graphics[/h1]
The visual fidelity of Corona MotorSport is now at an all time peak, without sacrificing performance.
[list]
[*]Upgraded to HD Render Pipeline framework
[*]New photo-realistic shaders for environment and vehicles
[*]Remastered environments and lighting - lighting is now precomputed for maximum performance and quality
[/list]
[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
The centerpieces of Corona MotorSport, reimagined.
[list]
[*]All vehicles have been painstakingly re-modeled and re-textured with more detail
[*]Users can now change the interior colors
[/list]
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dubai International Circuit - Day and Night
[*]New main menu and environment
[/list]

Stay tuned guys!

notes.title: Update 3.04 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
After over 7 months of hard work, I have finally finished the update and it is now live on Steam!

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated engine to Unity 2017.2
[*]New sky system
[*]Complete graphics overhaul - updated post processing, reworked lighting system, improved reflections
[*]Major physics improvements
[*]Major AI improvements - drivers are smarter, lose control less and are harder to beat
[*]UI overhaul - new main menu and pause menu UI
[*]New HUD design
[*]New car - Factory Five Type 65-R
[*]Added detailed animated suspension system to MK4 and Type 65 coupe
[*]New driver model and improved IK solving
[*]Steering wheel now shakes at high speeds (visual improvement)
[*]New Track - Barcelona
[*]New spawning system - spawning errors and game breaking bugs should be much less frequent when loading a level
[*]New main menu level
[*]New vehicle sound system - realistic engine sounds
[*]Improved geometry of vehicles - added detail to models instead of just using normal maps and textures
[*]New color picker - user can now pick manufacturer colors for each vehicle with different shader properties for added realism
[*]Settings menu - now fully functional and glitch-free - Resolution settings can only be changed before launching game, everything else can be changed in-game.
[*]Monza track - replaced billboard trees with SpeedTree trees, replaced several buildings with more optimized and better looking versions, added pit garages with animated crew
[*]Removed deprecated and redundant assets from build, size slightly reduced
[*]Switched to 64-bit executable - game will only run on 64 bit machines due to performance and RAM requirements. Please let me know if you are on a 32 bit machine so I can try and continue supporting 32 bit if necessary, it is outdated but I won't alienate my customers :)
[*]Performance improvements
[/list]

[h1]Removed features[/h1]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
These will all return in the next patch as they are still being worked on
[list]
[*]Serato Stretto - currently setting up physics for vehicle
[*]Tonnerre Serpent - Redesigning body and optimizing model
[*]Chevette G1 - Redesigning vehicle
[/list]

[b]Tracks[/b]
These will all return in the next patch as they are still being worked on
[list]
[*]Daytona - Model is just too hideous and riddled with problems, currently being redesigned
[*]Taghkhanic - Collision issues with track that needed to be fixed
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
These will all return in the next patch as they are still being worked on
[list]
[*]Volumetric Grass - bogged down performance, caused mesh errors (random spots of black and flickering) and is not compiling in Unity 2017
[/list]

I hope you all enjoy this update and I look forward to finishing Corona MotorSport in the coming months!

As always,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8068925/dca660010c0ef05cd352d997fda111e6fe5b9b86.png[/img]
Luke Japaridze
LucasGame Studios

notes.title: Update 3.02 Progress
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
Update 3.02 will be releasing as soon as possible, in a effort to improve the overall quality of the game, [b]I decided to rebuild the project from the ground up.[/b] AKA, create a new project folder in unity and copy the bare essentials over and rework the core framework of the game. This will eliminate redundant assets (reduce build size and build time), allow me to improve vehicle physics until a new package is available or I develop an in-house solution, re-do lighting, scene management and just improve the overall game experience. This will also allow me to fix issues with the racing AI.

As noted in the roadmap, Mac and Linux support have been pushed back to the next update. The main reason is compatibility, the resolution manager does not work on Linux (compiler errors, uses windows only libraries) and technical difficulties with getting the right linux driver for my graphics card to utilise all available power. Same issue with Mac support. Once I can provide a workaround, I'll start supporting Mac and Linux.

As for multiplayer, that's still a work in progress, thanks to everyone that is participating in the closed beta, I'm working hard on fixing the bugs and optimizing the experience.

I do have some good news: Update 3.02 will also feature a new track!
Thanks for your continued support!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8068925/dca660010c0ef05cd352d997fda111e6fe5b9b86.png[/img]
Luke Japaridze
LucasGame Studios

Update 2.07 is here! I apoligize for the delay, I got hit with a lot of schoolwork and a lot of bugs. [*]Damage System (some vehicles only) - Wheel detachment, hinge damage (doors, trunk, hood, etc), improved mesh deformation
[*]Improved UI in-game - RPM bar now changes color to indicate optimal shift times, detailed info about vehicle in lower left hand corner, damage indicator (MK4 Roadster only)
[*]Pause Menu - Completely redone, new icons, 3d effect
[*]New weather option - Fog
[*]Camera system - Press x to look behind (any camera view), camera now follows and damps z-rotation of target (noticeable sway/rotation matching when banking)
[*]Driver model - New driver model, basic facial animations (eye blink and movement), improved rig, higher detailed clothing, fixed hand and foot placement for some cars
[*]Obey V10 - new sounds, performance and dashboard
[*]Chevette G1 - Fixed color changing of interior
[*]Audio Improvements - new sounds for some vehicles, reverb on all tracks (echo)
[*]Monza Track - Fixed placement of trees (no longer glitching outside of barriers), lighting fixes for day and night, misc performance fixes
[*]Ambient Occlusion - replaced screen space version with new image effect, eliminates "scan-line" effect when moving camera
[*]Steamworks integration - taking screenshots in the main menu will properly hide UI, bug found - taking screenshot while at the main menu (menu with pictures to select car, track, etc) will cause a UI resize, please take screenshots when in photo mode or before clicking begin for now, I will patch this tomorrow. If you launch the game without steam, it will reboot and attempt to launch from steam.
[/list]
I hope you all enjoy this update! I will be releasing a hotfix within the next few days to fix all known bugs (and unknown, please do let me know if you find something).

notes.title: Update 2.06 releasing March 13th!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
Been very busy with the latest update. So far, numerous bugfixes have been made along with some performance improvements. A full settings menu will (finally) be present with the ability to recall previously saved settings. A new, simple, lag-free menu (the showroom will still be accessible) and a full on weather system (new sky package).
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bBSVeqG.png[/img]
The date will be synched to your system date for accurate sun, moon, and star position calculations while the in-game days will last 24 minutes. This new system will improve overall game performance and increase it's visual quality. Atmospheric scattering has been implemented as well. As the weather changes, so will the qualities of the track. For example if it begins to rain, the track will become more slippery, pretty self explanitory. I hope to have racing AI included in this update, if not, I will be purchasing a different AI physics package as the one I have gotten (was present in earlier versions of the game) is very glitchy, difficult to setup properly and behaves erratically. 

We are nearing the one year anniversary (March 13th) of Corona MotorSport's initial launch on steam. It's been a great year and I can't thank you guys enough for your support, I never dreamed of getting this far and I look forward to continue developing for steam for many years to come. I can't provide an exact date as to when corona motorsport will be fully finished and transfer to a full title release but I can promise the journey will be great. As I've mentioned before, I am currently working out licensing deals with several vehicle manufacturers so I can promise many new real-world cars this year. I am planning on doing something big for the one year anniversary so this update will be the best one yet :)
Luke Japaridze
LucasGame Studios
